discussion_comments.comment_body: Agreed — extracting a reusable `AdvancedPathSettings` component would reduce duplication. Noted for a follow-up. Kept inline for now to minimize the diff footprint and stay consistent with how the existing modals are structured (each modal is self-contained).
Fixed in cd05e03 — added `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls="advanced-settings"`, and `aria-hidden="true"` on the decorative chevron across all three toggle buttons.
